required.name: Certificate III (or higher) in Boilermaking/Heavy Fabrication
required.hint: Certificate III/Cert III/Cert 3 in Engineering (Boilermaker/Heavy Fabrication)

required.name: Minimum 2 years post-trade experience
required.hint: 2+ years post-qualification in boilermaker/fabrication roles (do NOT count apprenticeship)

required.name: Queensland coal-mining experience
required.hint: QLD coal sites e.g., Goonyella, Blackwater, Moranbah, etc.

positives.name: Stackers, reclaimers, shiploaders, or port infrastructure
Work with reputable mining contractors
positives.hint: Kaefer, Monadelphous, Richglen, CQ Field, FMS Group

red_flags.name: Candidate explicitly located outside Australia
red_flags.hint: If location text clearly outside AU → red flag. If missing/unclear → mark Unknown.

notes.unknown_policy: If evidence for a required item is unclear or not explicit, mark Unknown (do not guess). With max_unknown_required=0, any Unknown on required → Unsure.
notes.experience_policy: Only count post-trade employment towards exp_2yrs; exclude apprenticeship/trainee time.
